name: oa-sdk
description: OpenAPI 3.2 management monorepo — modular schemas, codegen bridge, mock server

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser build && pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen build && pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/mock-server build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser test && pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen test && pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/mock-server test && pnpm --filter playground test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser typecheck && pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen typecheck && pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/mock-server typecheck
